scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('server')){ cp.execSync('cd server && npm install && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('server/dist/server.js')){ require('./server/dist/server.js'); } else if(fs.existsSync('dist/server.js')){ require('./dist/server.js'); } else if(fs.existsSync('server/server.js')){ require('./server/server.js'); } else { require('./server.js'); }"
